arxiv-2011-05381.title: Dirichlet policies for reinforced factor portfolios
arxiv-2011-05381.creator: Eric André, Guillaume Coqueret
arxiv-2011-05381.description: Abstract This article aims to combine factor investing and reinforcement learning (RL). The agent learns through sequential random allocations which rely on firms’ characteristics. Using Dirichlet distributions as the driving policy, we derive closed forms for the policy gradients and analytical properties of the performance measure.

arxiv-2205-12469.title: Logical Satisfiability of Counterfactuals for Faithful Explanations in NLI
arxiv-2205-12469.creator: Suzanna Sia, Anton Belyy, Amjad Almahairi, Madian Khabsa, Luke Zettlemoyer, Lambert Mathias, [.1em] Johns Hopkins University Meta AI Research
arxiv-2205-12469.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Suzanna Sia, Anton Belyy, Amjad Almahairi, Madian Khabsa, Luke Zettlemoyer, Lambert Mathias, [.1em] Johns Hopkins University Meta AI Research. Evaluating an explanation’s faithfulness is desired for many reasons such as trust, interpretability and diagnosing the sources of model’s errors.

arxiv-2401-15417.title: Fault Diagnosis on Induction Motor using Machine Learning and Signal Processing
arxiv-2401-15417.creator: Muhammad Samiullah ID, Hasan Ali, Shehryar Zahoor, Anas Ali
arxiv-2401-15417.description: Abstract The detection and identification of induction motor faults using machine learning and signal processing is a valuable approach to avoiding plant disturbances and shutdowns in the context of Industry 4.0. In this work, we present a study on the detection and identification of induction motor faults using machine learning and signal processing with MATLAB Simulink.

arxiv-2502-01942.title: Boundary-Driven Table-Filling with Cross-Granularity Contrastive Learning for Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction
arxiv-2502-01942.creator: Qingling Li 1 , Wushao Wen 1, ⋆ \star , Jinghui Qin 2,3, ⋆ \star
arxiv-2502-01942.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qingling Li 1 , Wushao Wen 1, ⋆ \star , Jinghui Qin 2,3, ⋆ \star. The Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) task aims to extract aspect terms, opinion terms, and their corresponding sentiment polarity from a given sentence. It remains one of the most prominent subtasks in fine-grained sentiment analysis. Most existing approaches frame triplet extraction as a 2D table-filling process in an end-to-end manner, focusing primarily on word-level interactions while often overlooking sentence-level representations.

arxiv-2508-06480.title: Slantwise convection and heat transport in the icy moon oceans
arxiv-2508-06480.description: Abstract Ocean heat transport on icy moons shapes the ice shell topography, a primary observable of these moons. Two key processes control the heat transport: baroclinic instability driven by surface buoyancy contrasts and convective instability driven by heating from the core.

arxiv-2512-11135.title: Network and Compiler Optimizations for Efficient Linear Algebra Kernels in Private Transformer Inference * Equal contribution.
arxiv-2512-11135.creator: Karthik Garimella *, Negar Neda *, Austin Ebel *, Nandan Kumar Jha, Brandon Reagen
arxiv-2512-11135.description: Abstract Large language model (LLM) based services are primarily structured as client-server interactions, with clients sending queries directly to cloud providers that host LLMs. This approach currently compromises data privacy as all queries must be processed in the cloud and in the clear.

pmc-11350172.title: Transforming cyclopropanes to enamides via σ-C–C bond eliminative borylation
pmc-11350172.creator: Shuyu Kang, Jiahang Lv, Tianhang Wang, Bingcheng Wu, Minyan Wang, Zhuangzhi Shi
pmc-11350172.description: Recent strides in C–H borylation have significantly expanded our toolkit for the preparation of organoboronates. Nevertheless, avenues alternative to obtain these compounds via σ-C–C cleavage, thereby facilitating molecular scaffold editing, remain scarce. Several methodologies have been proposed for hydroboration of cyclopropanes by activating C–C bonds, conventionally relying on noble and hazardous metal catalysts to control reaction outcomes.

pmc-11490414.title: Post-traumatic osteoarthritic-mediated changes in condylar shape do not covary with changes in the internal microstructure of the bone
pmc-11490414.creator: Zach Skabelund, Dakshina Acharya, Jonathan Banks, Minahil Chaudhry, Chun-Chieh Huang, Christina Nicholas, David Reed
pmc-11490414.description: Post-traumatic osteoarthritis (PTOA) in the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) is associated with remodeling of the subchondral bone. This remodeling changes both the external appearance of the condylar bone and the internal bony microstructure. The external geometry can be quantified using shape, a multivariate mathematical measurement that contains all of the structure’s geometric information with location, scale, and rotation effects removed.

pmc-11528357.title: Agents seeking long-term access to the wisdom of the crowd reduce immediate decision-making accuracy
pmc-11528357.creator: Richard P. Mann
pmc-11528357.description: Living in groups offers social animals the significant advantage of accessing collective wisdom and enhanced information processing, enabling more accurate decisions related to foraging, navigation and habitat selection. Preserving group membership is crucial for sustaining access to collective wisdom, incentivizing animals to prioritize group cohesion.

pmc-11611891.title: Risky sexual practice and associated factors among antiretroviral therapy attendees in public health facilities, Wolaita Zone, South Ethiopia: a multi-center cross-sectional study
pmc-11611891.creator: Sisay Petros Salato, Befekadu Bekele Besha, Esayas Aydiko Amele, Temesgen Lera Abiso
pmc-11611891.description: BackgroundThe majority of people living with Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) are in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. Increased risky sexual practice puts people living with the human immune virus at higher risk of acquiring sexually transmitted infections other than the human immune virus and unplanned pregnancies.

pmc-11677194.title: Sensitive and Discriminative Fluorescent Detection of Volatile Primary Aliphatic Diamine Vapors from Monoamines
pmc-11677194.creator: Agostino Attinà, Ivan Pietro Oliveri, Massimiliano Gaeta, Santo Di Bella, Takuya Terai
pmc-11677194.description: The discriminative detection of volatile primary aliphatic diamines (VPADs) is a relevant and timely issue. This paper explores the distinctive optical features of H-type and J-type aggregates on paper-based (PB) films, namely H-PB and J-PB films, respectively, of a Lewis acidic Zn(salen)-type complex upon chemisorption of vapors of ditopic VPADs versus those of monotopic volatile amines.

pmc-12516391.title: The healing process of vertebral body fracture in Wistar rats: creation of an animal model and demonstration of the impact of anterolateral vascularization disruption on bone healing
pmc-12516391.creator: Diogo Lino Moura, Diogo Casal, Sara Alves, Rui Almeida, Diogo Pais, José Casanova, António Bernardes
pmc-12516391.description: BackgroundAlthough recognition of avascular necrosis of the vertebral body in post-traumatic cases has increased, it remains underdiagnosed and is one of the most unpredictable and challenging complications in spinal trauma. Vertebral arterial supply may play a key role in fracture healing, yet this remains unproven and is not currently considered in treatment algorithms.

pmc-12555826.title: Conservative treatment of ameloblastic fibroma a case report with review of literature
pmc-12555826.creator: Gerardo Bardales Arguelles, Francisco Díaz Ayala, Claudette Marcelle Arambú Turcios, Gustavo Alberto Sierra Larios, Hugo Romero Alvarenga, Juan José Guifarro Sierra
pmc-12555826.description: Introduction and importanceAmeloblastic fibroma (AF) is a benign mixed odontogenic tumor composed of epithelial and mesenchymal tissues. It accounts for approximately 1.5–4.5 % of all odontogenic tumors and is most commonly diagnosed during the first and second decades of life. Due to documented cases of malignant transformation, the optimal therapeutic approach for AF remains a subject of debate.

pmc-12696343.title: Retropseudogene insertion generated through retrotransposition in the ATP7A gene results in premature stop codons and a case of Menkes disease
pmc-12696343.creator: Mengyao Kou, Bin Ren, Mengnan Xing, Lijuan Chen, Xiangping Xu
pmc-12696343.description: Pathogenic variants in the ATP7A gene, which encodes a transmembrane copper-transporting P-type ATPase, underlie Menkes disease, a rare X-linked recessive disorder of copper metabolism. We report a 3-year-old boy presenting with progressive neurodegeneration, refractory epilepsy, connective tissue abnormalities, and characteristic kinky hair.

pmc-12723490.title: Point-of-care C-reactive protein testing in general practice out-of-hours services: tool or trap?
pmc-12723490.creator: Rebecca Payne, Sarah Mills, Clare Wilkinson, Malene Plejdrup Hansen
pmc-12723490.description: (defined as unscheduled, urgent primary care, occurring outwith normal office hours). In this setting a high proportion of consultations result in an antibiotic prescription, with 59% of these being prescribed for respiratory tract infections. 2 This high use of antibiotics in GP out-of-hours is unsurprising but concerning.

pmc-13087232.title: Distinct functional networks derived from human induced pluripotent stem cell neuronal activity
pmc-13087232.creator: Steve Mehrkanoon, Ben Rollo, Jinchao Gu, Muhammad Shahid Javaid, Ana Antonic-Baker, Terence J. O’Brien, Patrick Kwan
pmc-13087232.description: We characterised the development of spikes, bursts and functional networks in neurons derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) over a 55-day culture period. Spontaneous neuronal activity was recorded using a multi-electrode array across 20 non-consecutive days. The aim was to track neural maturation by identifying the spatiotemporal patterns of functional connectivity.

pmc-13090962.title: BRCA1 and BRCA2 pathogenic variants increase the risk of four less common cancer types
pmc-13090962.creator: H Sasagawa, M Endo, Y Iwasaki, Y Usui, YN Koyanagi, G Innella, J Hadler, MT Parsons, K Numakura, Y Kamatani, Y Murakami, K Matsuo, K Matsuda, AB Spurdle, T Habuchi, Y Momozawa
pmc-13090962.description: BackgroundPrevious family-based and case-control studies have expanded the cancer risk profile associated with pathogenic variants in BRCA1 and BRCA2, providing the potential for expanding personalized medicine. Less common cancer types may benefit greatly from such expansion of genetic evidence because of their limited treatments and poor prognoses.

pmc-13215556.title: Modeling the microbial contribution to human energy balance using the Digestion, Absorption, and Microbial Metabolism (DAMM) model
pmc-13215556.creator: Taylor L. Davis, Blake Dirks, Elvis A. Carnero, Karen D. Corbin, Steven R. Smith, Andrew Marcus, Rosa Krajmalnik-Brown, Bruce E. Rittmann
pmc-13215556.description: Colonic microorganisms have been linked to human health and disease, specifically metabolic disease states such as obesity, but causal relationships remain to be established. Previous work demonstrated that interactions between the host’s diet and intestinal microbiome were associated with human energy balance by affecting the human’s energy absorption, quantified by metabolizable energy.

pmc-13363640.title: Long-Term Bending Behavior of Laminated Glass Plate with Temperature-Dependent Viscoelastic Interlayer
pmc-13363640.creator: Xia Zhu, Kangyu Ni, Changkuo Xu, Aiguo Zhao, Peng Wu
pmc-13363640.description: This study presents an analytical model for the long-term bending behavior of simply supported laminated glass (LG) plates with temperature-dependent viscoelastic interlayers. The glass layers are described based on three-dimensional elasticity theory, and the governing stress and displacement equations are formulated using the state-space method.

pmc-13374969.title: Temporal evolution of carbon footprint and emission reduction pathways of major crops in Inner mongolia under China’s dual-carbon goals
pmc-13374969.creator: Jiuwei Chi, Na Liu, Fang Wang, Jingran Yu, Xiao Zhang, Chuang Yue, Rifu Bada
pmc-13374969.description: As an important grain-producing region in northern China, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is characterized by arid and semi-arid agricultural ecosystems, limited water resources, and relatively high dependence on agricultural inputs such as irrigation, chemical fertilizers, diesel fuel, and plastic film mulching.

pmc-13594895.title: High-resolution spatial transcriptomics of irradiated submandibular glands treated with fortified fibrin hydrogels
pmc-13594895.creator: Kihoon Nam, Mark Maienschein-Cline, Harim Tavares dos Santos, Frank M Maslow, Rodrigo A Osorio, Stelios T Andreadis, Olga J Baker
pmc-13594895.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryPrevious studies showed that fortified fibrin hydrogel (Ep-FH), generated by conjugating laminin-1 peptides (A99 and YIGSR) and growth factors (FGF7 and FGF10) to fibrin hydrogels, improves epithelial organization and secretory function in irradiated mouse submandibular glands (SMG). To define the cell type-specific mechanisms underlying these effects, we generated high-resolution spatial transcriptomic profiles using the Xenium Prime Mouse Pan Tissue and Pathways Panel (5,000 genes).
